You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (49.9 s) ===
[0.0-3.8] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as Juliana rises from her stool to stand close in front of him, reaching an affectionate hand toward his temple.
[2.0-3.8] JULIANA (Gentle, Tender): "I could trim them for you."
[3.8-5.1] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hand firmly but gently catching Juliana's wrist in midair.
[5.1-7.4] SCREEN: Medium two-shot profile of Alexander holding her wrist, his piercing gaze locked onto hers.
[5.1-6.4] ALEXANDER (Firm, Low): "Not yet."
[7.4-9.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking into his eyes, her brow lightly furrowed in bemused question.
[7.7-8.8] JULIANA (Puzzled, Curious): "Not yet?"
[9.2-11.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander, still maintaining his gentle hold on her arm.
[9.6-10.8] ALEXANDER (Grounded, Steady): "Let them grow."
[11.5-14.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana smiling with playful warmth.
[11.8-13.9] JULIANA (Playful, Amused): "You prefer looking like a forest hermit?"
[14.2-16.8] SCREEN: Intimate two-shot as Alexander slowly lowers her hand, his expression softening.
[15.6-16.8] ALEXANDER (Dry, Droll): "It has advantages."
[16.8-18.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana chuckling quietly as she steps back toward the table.
[17.4-18.7] JULIANA (Fond, Resigned): "Very well."
[18.8-19.9] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander watching her with deep, affectionate attention.
[19.9-21.9] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana grinning with sparkling eyes.
[20.0-21.5] JULIANA (Teasing, Determined): "But one day, I am trimming that beard."
[21.9-23.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander lowering his head slightly with a faint smirk.
[22.0-23.1] ALEXANDER (Low, Amused): "We'll see."
[23.2-25.2] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of both sitting back down at the table together, Alexander turning a brittle page of the herb book.
[25.2-29.0] SCREEN: Close-up insert of Alexander's weathered finger pointing directly at a delicate botanical illustration of a flowering stem.
[25.2-28.9] ALEXANDER (Instructional, Calm): "That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling."
[29.0-31.7] SCREEN: Wide side-profile two-shot of Juliana and Alexander seated across from each other at the rustic table, the stone fireplace roaring warmly behind them.
[30.6-32.1] JULIANA (Soft, Nostalgic): "My mother wrote the same thing."
[31.7-34.9] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking across at his battle-marked features with empathy.
[32.4-34.7] JULIANA (Hesitant, Compassionate): "And the scars... were they from the war?"
[34.9-36.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander looking downward, memories clouding his eyes.
[35.1-36.1] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Subdued): "Some were."
[36.2-38.4] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with gentle understanding.
[36.8-38.2] JULIANA (Tender, Aching): "It must have been terrible."
[38.4-40.4] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander lifting his gaze, heavy with past battles.
[38.6-39.5] ALEXANDER (Heavy, Somber): "It was."
[40.4-42.8] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Juliana smiling tenderly at him across the open book.
[40.9-44.0] JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable): "I thought losing wealth meant losing everything."
[42.8-45.1] SCREEN: Wide shot framing the warm silhouette of the two companions sitting peacefully beside the blazing stone hearth.
[45.1-49.9] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana's radiant face illuminated by firelight, a peaceful, contented smile spreading across her lips as she looks at him until the shot gently fades out.
[45.1-47.2] JULIANA (Quiet, Transformed): "Perhaps I was wrong."
[47.2-49.9] ACTION: Juliana maintains her warm, peaceful gaze across the table as soft firelight flickers over her face into fade out.

[8.9-11.3] JULIANA (Observant, Lightly Teasing): "You know more about healing than you let on."
